# This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public

# file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
---
loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader

kind-dependencies:
    - toolchain
    - fetch

transforms:
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.build:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.build_attrs:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.build_lints:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.mozconfig:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.job:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms

task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    worker-type: b-linux-docker-large-amd
    index:
        product: thunderbird
    treeherder:
        symbol: Searchfox(idx)
        kind: build
        tier: 2
    run-on-projects: []
    optimization: null
    use-python: default

tasks:
    linux64-searchfox/debug:
        description: "Linux64 Debug Searchfox"
        index:
            job-name: linux64-searchfox-debug
        treeherder:
            platform: linux64/debug
        worker:
            max-run-time: 36000
            env:
                PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: searchfox
                MOZSEARCH_PLATFORM: "linux"
        mozconfig:
            variant: debug-searchfox-clang
        run:
            using: mozharness
            comm-checkout: true
            clone-with: hg
            actions: [build]
            config-paths:
                - comm/testing/mozharness/configs
            config:
                - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
                - builds/releng_sub_linux_configs/64_searchfox_and_debug.py
            script: "mozharness/scripts/fx_desktop_build.py"
            tooltool-downloads: public
            keep-artifacts: false
        fetches:
            toolchain:
                - linux64-cbindgen
                - linux64-clang
                - linux64-dump_syms
                - linux64-libotr
                - linux64-nasm
                - linux64-node
                - linux64-pkgconf
                - linux64-rust
                - linux64-rust-analyzer
                - sysroot-wasm32-wasi
                - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu

    macosx64-searchfox/debug:
        description: "MacOS X x64 Debug Cross-compile Searchfox"
        index:
            job-name: macosx64-searchfox-debug
        treeherder:
            platform: osx-cross/debug
        worker:
            max-run-time: 36000
            env:
                PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: searchfox
                MOZSEARCH_PLATFORM: "macosx"
        mozconfig:
            variant: debug-searchfox
        run:
            using: mozharness
            comm-checkout: true
            clone-with: hg
            actions: [build]
            config-paths:
                - comm/testing/mozharness/configs
            config:
                - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
                - builds/releng_base_mac_64_cross_builds.py
            script: "mozharness/scripts/fx_desktop_build.py"
            custom-build-variant-cfg: cross-debug-searchfox
            keep-artifacts: false
        fetches:
            toolchain:
                - linux64-cbindgen
                - linux64-cctools-port
                - linux64-clang
                - linux64-dump_syms
                - linux64-hfsplus
                - linux64-libdmg
                - linux64-nasm
                - linux64-node
                - linux64-rust-analyzer
                - linux64-rust-cross
                - macosx64-x64-libotr
                - macosx64-sdk
                - sysroot-wasm32-wasi
                - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu

    win64-searchfox/debug:
        description: "Win64 Searchfox Debug (clang)"
        index:
            job-name: win64-searchfox-debug
        treeherder:
            platform: windows2012-64/debug
        worker:
            max-run-time: 36000
            env:
                PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: searchfox
                MOZSEARCH_PLATFORM: "windows"
        mozconfig:
            variant: debug-searchfox
        run:
            using: mozharness
            comm-checkout: true
            clone-with: hg
            options: [append-env-variables-from-configs]
            actions: [build]
            config-paths:
                - comm/testing/mozharness/configs
            script: mozharness/scripts/fx_desktop_build.py
            config:
                - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
                - builds/releng_base_linux_64_builds.py
                - builds/taskcluster_sub_win64/searchfox_debug.py
            tooltool-downloads: internal
        fetches:
            toolchain:
                - linux64-7zz
                - linux64-cbindgen
                - linux64-clang
                - linux64-dump_syms
                - linux64-nasm
                - linux64-node
                - linux64-rust-analyzer
                - linux64-rust-cross
                - linux64-rust-size
                - linux64-upx
                - linux64-winchecksec
                - linux64-wine
                - nsis
                - sysroot-wasm32-wasi
                - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
                - vs
                - win64-libotr
                - winappsdk-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            fetch:
                - windows-rs
